description: W_λ per-body-order specification from the extensive-series cumulant profile: collective-determinant Ursell cumulants vs AME, giving the correction W_λ must inject per body order. Audit-only; no fit; no closure; no selection.
tier: exploratory (diagnostic specification for the W_λ frontier)

result.wlambda_specification: W_λ per-body-order spec (signed correction AME − det, relative to the collective determinant at g=0.4467): b₂ det/AME=0.419, correction +1.293 MeV/pair (W_λ RAISES the 2-body — the open-bond linear deficit, since det treats the single pair as a loop; the proved 5g=2.2336 in-unit already supplies it); b₃ det/AME=1.042, correction -0.060 MeV (≈right, small); b₄ det/AME=1.629, correction -5.814 MeV (W_λ LOWERS the connected 4-body — det over-supplies it). So W_λ's signature is signed (+, ≈0, −): raise the 2-body (open bond), leave 3-body ≈ intact, lower the connected 4-body. Scope-(a); no fit, no closure.
